title: Create: Brass Tiles
description: The most excruciating process to make a decoration block.
body:
# !!! Warning !!!
This is my first Minecraft mod with real code ever. I use KubeJS to make this mod, which is sometimes limiting. If you have any complaints, I _might_ be able to try and fix it, but if it isn't fixed, just know that I tried. I also suck at texturing using Blockbench, so the textures aren't very good.

# stupid processing co presents: **Create: Brass Tiles**
Ever wanted to create a cool decoration block, and thought it was easy? Screw that easy part - **Create: Brass Tiles** is here!

To create a singular non-tiling decoration block, you need these items:

# Brass Tile Frame
A filled frame with brass inside. You need it to get the Brass Tile Face. But getting the frame isn't very simple...

![Brass Tile Frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae669f0d5032a4da43b3fe82842bd74c1e0fb275.png)

# Brass Tile Face
The face of the the Brass Tile block you apply to the Pattern Block. You might to do some reprocessing to get it though...

![Brass Tile Face](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24ac05b041b3e799f758f66deb568af40dcf49e3.png)

# Pattern Block
The block that you apply the face to, with an _actually straight forward recipe for once._

![Pattern Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b67ee5ba261bcf9789f6536149d10968a4405f7.png)

And that isn't even everything!
# Dependencies
These should automatically install, but if they don't, just download them from here. Click them to open their mod pages.
